name: verification-admission-repair
goal: Declared headless scenario commands admit one registered test and record actual assertions; profiler bootstrap and Mac probe fixtures remain bounded.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Prior Codex module-tasks scenario declared multiple files for a one-file wrapper and omitted registered scopes. The existing design-option capture also deadlocked in profiler schema bootstrap; fresh-script admission prevented a Mac fixture from starting inside its unchanged 500ms limit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Custom loop commands had been trusted without executing declared scenario targets. Normal self-verify-config now validates every headless wrapper signature, package and registered states; cold runner coverage imports the real transitive schema graph.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable profiler red checkpoint d481a078e26d9d0a18ea5672c5c691422d23780929f0025484972aa8cad094ef reproduces the registry bootstrap self-wait on the frozen test corpus.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use one registered file per capture and validate headless declarations in normal checks. Load schema bootstrap before the lazy loader and launch Mac probe scripts through the installed interpreter.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Repair and guard are implemented at 3b3e7a529158cec33bff9efb77939c0e40d3502d. Normal self-verify-config checks every headless wrapper, test registration and state. Profiler schema loads before lazy runner selection; Mac probes launch via the installed interpreter.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired unchanged corpus at red 354af9df64631394b109fcf329a4729f5b90efde and green 3b3e7a529158cec33bff9efb77939c0e40d3502d: profiler records 380126b349ae893ee668f7c3d5f63b761892e2426e99b1d0219c9d476cd6f169 / d3f0314cd6ba9a8f019d56ba165a2437ba80ad4a56347ebeba6b9e6a857976c0. Real cold transitive schema graph passes within the unchanged five-second bound.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated fault injection at 421ef6f9047367c91ccd94ad8357c3277795d390 proved an extra wrapper argument and missing registered scope are both rejected; restored declarations pass. /tmp/harness-task-admission-isolated-proof.json retains the failing and restored results. The same guard passes in the full 1,311-test suite at 7be348611c0c1aecf824440a9c0fcdb48c8c61dc.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: The full standard hosted xvfb-run -a bun run check passed at f13d6d15e189a9195833dc49f063ab1b74737d57 in job121084549517 (Bun1.2.18). On harbor-mbp-2 the first complete aggregate failed at one concurrent-history seeding wait after root1311/25declared skips and CLI285 passed. The entire normal package command passed unchanged on retry (28+5, three declared scale skips), then every normal downstream format/type/lint/unit/build/audit and browser stage passed with the same1CPU/2048MiB reservation and clean source. Desktop973 units with three declared iOS skips plus232 browser cases/one declared skip; Hub479 units plus28 browser cases. Reports770, Planning56, Collaboration45, Remote135, Relay159 and Game27 pass. The final frozen1819-file test/config corpus also passes all five matched regression pairs; fresh local/hosted screenshots and live API list/contract/page-tab pixels were inspected. Final independent captures preserve application/test bytes across documentation-only bookkeeping. Paid live-provider completion, real quota fallback and physical devices are unproven; the separate full native CI verifier did not admit execution (resource wait timeout/no record), not a passing native or approved-budget proof. See module-task-analytics/verification.md and Project Reports run92efc4cd-d42a-46bd-afd0-a307cafb568c.
